lede: Wat Si Suphan accounts for 36 catalogued manuscripts, 4 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (97%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (86%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (14%). Dated witnesses run 1896–1970 CE (23 of 36 carry a date).
